projects.name: NJDOT Statewide Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Project Locations (Tran_STIP_24_33)
projects.notes: NJDOT GIS official layer of mappable FY2024-2033 STIP projects (planned/programmed). TOTAL and FY_2022..FY_2033 are programmed dollars in MILLIONS per fiscal year; the first FY column with money indicates timing. UPC is the NJDOT project number; CIS_SUBCATEGORY gives finer work type; MUNC1-4 municipalities; MPO field. CMSSTATUS and AWARD_DATE are mostly blank, so there is no reliable phase field: treat all rows as programmed/planned. Address changed 2026-11-20: the old service (…STIP_Project_Locations/FeatureServer/0) now answers 'Token Required'; NJDOT republished the same layer on 2026-11-19 as …STIP_Project_Locations__FY_24_33__/FeatureServer/1 (264 rows, same field names, verified by live query).

projects.name: NJDOT Current Capital Projects (hosted by Rutgers account, not NJDOT)
projects.notes: Small third-party-hosted (Rutgers user) copy of NJDOT capital projects in the delivery pipeline with design phase codes (Phase, e.g. CD=concept development) and In_the_STIP flag. No cost or dates; currency unknown, use as secondary only.

summary: NJDOT's STIP FY2024-2033 polyline layer (264 mapped projects, costs in $M by fiscal year) works for planned projects. No owner names: the statewide NJOGIS parcel/MOD-IV composite (https://services2.arcgis.com/XVOqAjTOJ5P6ngMu/arcgis/rest/services/Parcels_Composite_NJ_WM/FeatureServer/0, 3,481,240 parcels, verified) keeps the OWNER_NAME field but it is blank on every row, redacted for public web access under Daniel's Law; it still gives owner mailing address (ST_ADDRESS, CITY_STATE, ZIP_CODE), PROP_LOC, NET_VALUE, CALC_ACRE, COUNTY. No official county layer with owner names was found; only unofficial third-party copies on ArcGIS Online, not recorded.
